axes.name: dispersion_lookback_hours
axes.definition: Time-weighted lookback in completed hourly observations.

axes.name: entry_percentile
axes.definition: Quantile of prior-date dispersion observations. No fallback threshold; insufficient history means no signal.

axes.name: holding_hours
axes.definition: Fixed elapsed holding period; exit at first tradable hourly open at or after scheduled exit.

axes.name: portfolio_tail_fraction
axes.definition: Select highest-dispersion 10% or 20% of eligible assets; ties resolved by stable asset ID.

axes.name: minimum_eligible_venues
axes.definition: Minimum eligible venues for the same underlying at signal time.

enumeration.ordering: Cartesian product in declared axis order and listed value order.

universe.current_snapshot_use: candidate discovery only; never substitute for historical ranks

cost_scenarios.interpretation: Sensitivity assumption, not a venue fee claim.
Registered baseline unless verified public venue-specific costs are available.
Adverse cost sensitivity; never discarded after results are observed.

evaluation.validation_primary_endpoint: mean daily net portfolio return at <=1.0x gross exposure
evaluation.multiple_testing_correction: Holm correction across all 108 validation tests
evaluation.uncertainty: dependence-aware block bootstrap; disclose block choice and sensitivity
evaluation.holdout_policy: Do not inspect or tune against final holdout; evaluate FVD053 only after validation decision is frozen.
